Market today: The market's buzzing with AI, but there's a tug-of-war. On one side, continued innovation and demand for chips. On the other, talks of reining in AI costs and safety concerns. This directly impacts your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.8%) and SPAL (-37.89%) are bleeding badly; their leveraged nature amplifies these drops, especially on margin. QQQ (-1.42%), SMH (-14.81%), and QQQI (-4.47%) are all at SELL/TRIM status and near their stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any news regarding AI regulation or data center costs, as this could affect the broader tech sector. Also, monitor your stops on QQQ, SPY, SMH, and QQQI.

Bottom line: With significant losses in leveraged ETFs and several positions near stops, managing risk and protecting capital is your top priority.
plays: Review your SOXL and SPAL positions immediately. These leveraged ETFs are down significantly, and their decay combined with margin amplifies risk.
Respect your stops on QQQ, SPY, SMH, and QQQI. These are at SELL/TRIM status and near their stop levels.
Consider QCOM as a new buy (entry 187.31-187.13, stop 186.42). Its strong scanner signal aligns with positive chip sector sentiment.
